decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

Existing Drawings
2401-EX-01, 2401-EX-10 (Rev A), 2401-EX-11 (Rev A), 2401-EX-12 (Rev A), 2401-EX-20 (Rev A), 2401-EX-21 (Rev A), 2401-EX-22 (Rev A), 2401-EX-30 (Rev A), 2401-EX-31 (Rev A), 2401-EX-32 (Rev A), Site Location Plan (16/02/2026)

Demolition Drawings
2401-PL-50 (Rev A), 2401-PL-51 (Rev A), 2401-PL-52 (Rev A), 2401-PL-54 (Rev A), 2401-PL-55 (Rev A), 2401-PL-56 (Rev A), 2401-PL-57 (Rev A), 2401-PL-58

Proposed Drawings
2401-PL-10 (Rev C), 2401-PL-11 (Rev B), 2401-PL-12 (Rev B), 2401-PL-20 (Rev B), 2401-PL-21 (Rev B), 2401-PL-22 (Rev B), 2401-PL-30 (Rev B), 2401-PL-31 (Rev B) 2401-PL-32 (Rev B),  2401-D-300 (Rev A), 2401-D-301, 2401-D-302, JB25-01 (Rev B)

Elements and Proposed restoration/alterations Sheets
Roof Garden (Rev 2), Fascias (Rev 2), Ceilings (Rev 2), Garage/Bedsit ceiling and roof (Rev 2), Greenhouse (Rev 2), Rooflights to garden roof (Rev 2), Balustrades (Rev 2), Jarrah Structure (Rev 2), Pergola (Rev 2), Roof boiler room (Rev 2), Studio roof and rooflight (Rev 2), Timber windows and sliding doors (Rev 2), Timber windows and doors to garage/bedsit (Rev 2), Timber arch window to the studio, Front door and canopy (Rev 2), Stair (Rev 2), Floors (Rev 2), Floors (Rev 2), Internal doors and ironmongery (Rev 2), Services-lighting (Rev 2), Services - heating and hot water (Rev 2), Services - Electrics (Rev 2), Brickwork, repairs and cleaning (Rev 2), Joinery (Rev 2), Entrance and dining room (Rev 2), Kitchen (Rev 2), Bedroom 1 (Rev 2), Passage (Rev 2), Bathroom (Rev 2), Bedrooms 2 and 3 (Rev 2), Master bedroom (Rev 2), Living room (Rev 2), Studio (Rev 2), Garage/bedsit (rev 2)

Supporting Documents
Planning Statement February 2026 (Rev 1), Design Statement February 2026, Environmental Noise Survey and Plant Noise Assessment Report (32878/PNA1 (13/01/2026)


Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development with specified noise mitigation hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017


Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
description: Erection of first floor studio extension, replacement of rooftop conservatory, fenestration improvements, internal alterations, removal of shed and landscape alterations including new pool, plant enclosure, pergola, bin store and fencing
